title: Return the same message
summary: WebSockets: Return the same message. Send Sun Trip instead.
introduction: An echo server sends received text back unchanged. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return the same message with WebSockets

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Return the same message

blocks.text: The server converts received bytes to a string and sends the same characters back.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Node ws receives Buffer data by default; turn text into a string.
